description: store/mod.rs MailStore is a supertrait of ~10 sub-traits. The SqlxMailStore implements all of them. However, the oracle.rs stub is stated to 'compile but all methods return Err(not_implemented)'. If a new sub-trait is added to MailStore without adding a method to OracleMailStore, the code still compiles (blanket NOT_IMPLEMENTED impl may cover it), but the oracle fails silently at runtime instead of failing at compile time. Add a compile_check() or use a sealed trait pattern to make the compiler enforce completeness.
title: mail: MailStore supertrait has no object-safe boundary check — dyn MailStore may silently drop sub-trait methods
